verdict.rationale: Adyen documents webhooks for network token lifecycle events and states that adding an Adyen-issued card to Apple Pay or Google Pay replaces the card data with a network token. That gives developers some event-driven visibility into tokens created for a card. There is no evidence of first-class token management. Missing for 10: an API to list or retrieve tokens per card, explicit identification of the wallet or merchant token requestor, token-level suspend or revoke independent of the PAN, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
